name: mod.yagens_attributes.galvanized_argon_scope

capacity.description: Mod capacity used at level 0 and additional capacity per level. Total capacity cost is base + per_level * level.

max_level_description: Maximum inclusive Mod level. Level 0 is a usable Mod and every entry scales with (level + 1).

entries.description: Fractional critical chance Addition at rank 0 while the weak point hit buff is active. Scales with (rank + 1).

condition.description: Confirmed ranged weak point hits build or refresh the weapon buff. The bonus applies at launch. scale_duration_with_rank multiplies the rank 0 duration by (rank + 1).

entries.description: Fractional critical chance Addition at rank 0 per active weak point kill stack. Scales with (rank + 1).

condition.description: Direct ranged weak point kills build the weapon buff. The bonus applies at launch. Qualifying kills add a stack, capped at max_stacks. all_at_once refreshes all layers and expires together; one_at_a_time refreshes the next expiry then removes one layer per duration_seconds; independent gives each layer its own expiry and replaces the earliest expiry at capacity. per_target_status multiplies the active kill count by distinct independent target proc types before this hit, ignoring potion effects. Duration and stack cap do not scale with rank.
